hero_sub: Video surveillance, access control, smart locks and metal doors. Professional installation with warranty.
services_sub: Complete security solutions for your home and business
svc_video_desc: Analogue and IP cameras, recording systems, remote monitoring 24/7. Installation in apartments, houses and businesses.
svc_access_desc: Electronic locks, keypad panels, card readers and biometric systems for buildings and offices.
svc_smart_desc: Tedee, Yale and other smart locks with phone, code or card access. Installation and configuration.
svc_safe_desc: Home and office safes for storing cash, documents and valuables. Installation, opening and repair.
svc_fire_desc: Smoke detectors, automatic alarms and warning systems for residential and commercial buildings.
svc_doors_desc: Secure metal entrance doors with certified locks. Installation, repair and replacement.
svc_locks_desc: High-security mechanical and electronic locks. Installation, repair, key cutting and emergency opening.
why_region: We serve Riga, Jūrmala, Mārupe, Ķekava, Olaine and Salaspils. We work with both private individuals and businesses.

svc_cta_sub: Contact us — we'll help you choose the right solution.
svc_video_about_p1: Video surveillance systems are the most effective way to secure your property. Modern cameras deliver high-resolution images both day and night.
svc_video_about_p2: We design, supply and install video surveillance systems for homes, offices and businesses. Every project is tailored individually.
svc_video_f3: Remote monitoring from phone or computer
svc_access_about_p1: Access control systems let you precisely manage who can enter your premises and when. Essential for offices, warehouses and apartment buildings.
svc_access_about_p2: We offer solutions ranging from simple keypad panels to complex biometric systems with access logs and time tracking.
svc_smart_about_p1: Smart locks are the future — today. Open doors with your phone, a code or a card, no traditional keys needed. Perfect for Airbnb, offices and modern apartments.
svc_smart_about_p2: We are official Tedee partners in Latvia. We also install and configure Yale, Nuki and other brands.
svc_smart_f2: Access by phone, code or card
svc_safe_about_p1: Safes provide secure storage for physical valuables — cash, documents, jewellery and important media. We supply and install certified safes.
svc_safe_about_p2: We also help in emergencies — opening forgotten or damaged safes without damage, where possible.
svc_fire_about_p1: Fire alarm systems are a legal requirement for many premises, but above all — they save lives. Early smoke detection can save everything.
svc_fire_about_p2: We install certified systems for apartments, private homes and commercial premises. We also provide maintenance and inspections.
svc_doors_about_p1: Metal entrance doors are the first line of defence for your home or business. Modern metal doors are not only secure but also aesthetically pleasing.
svc_doors_about_p2: We supply and install metal doors with certified locks, additional protection layers and a choice of finish options.
svc_doors_f1: Steel doors with certified strength rating
svc_doors_f5: Installation and removal of old doors
svc_locks_about_p1: A quality lock is the foundation of any security system. We work with leading manufacturers and can find the optimal solution for any door type.
svc_locks_about_p2: We provide a full service — installation, repair, key cutting and emergency opening. We work with both mechanical and electronic locks.
